0022600216.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (8-2, 1st in the West) visit the Portland Trail Blazers (6-3, 8th in the West) with the Thunder on a four-game winning streak and 8-2 over their last ten, while Portland has lost two straight and sits 3rd in the Northwest, 1.5 games back. The Thunder are without Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Jaylin Williams (back, spasms) and Thomas Sorber (knee), and Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Robert Williams III (rest), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle). The Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 124-95 win in Oklahoma City on December 31, 2025, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
